Ka uje nga rrjeti dhe pus me sond.
Disponon dokumentacion te rregullt per truallin dhe ndertimin.
Per me teper detaje na kontaktoni!
title_en: Villa - For Sale - Peze Helmes, Tirana(ID: 530171090-1486)
description_en: Villa for sale, Peze Helmas The villa is only 20 minutes from Tirana. It is located on the old road of Durres. Land area 500 m2, construction area 339.5 m2. The villa is individual. The organization consists of 2 floors, the 1st floor is over 175.5 m2, it consists of an entrance hall, a separate kitchen, a separate living room, 2 bedrooms, a veranda, 1 bathroom (this floor has never been inhabited, it is without final refinishing). The 2nd floor is accessed from an external staircase, and has the same floor plan, external veranda, separate kitchen, separate living room, 1 bathroom, 2 bedrooms, veranda. The second floor has been refinished and modestly furnished, it has been lived in by the owners. The villa has a front yard, where parking for 2 or 3 cars can be used, and all around there is normal access to a country villa, behind the property there is a garden and some trees. There is water from the network and a borehole. Has regular documentation for the land and construction. For more details contact us!
